long_biography.plain_text:
Powell worked in funeral service before focusing on a simpler alternative to conventional ceremonies. She and Bryan launched Pure Cremation in 2015 after seeing demand for direct cremation, which separates an unattended cremation from a later celebration of life. Her operating role centred on customer experience, explaining the model to families while the company built a nationwide service.

Pure Cremation expanded into prepaid plans and built its own crematorium in Andover. Catherine and Bryan later joined other managers in a buyout that restored full management ownership. They completed the sale of the business to Epiris in 2023 and left their directorships that November. Both Powells remain significant controllers of UXL Properties, although the scale and composition of that company's assets are undisclosed.
